description: This file defines the ResultSet class for PurchaseList in the Coocook schema, including methods for retrieving default dates, checking if a purchase list is default, and counting ingredients and items.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::PurchaseList
classes.description: ResultSet class for handling collections of PurchaseList records with custom methods for date calculation and attribute augmentation.

methods.name: default_date
methods.description: Returns a DateTime object representing a suitable date for a new purchase list, either after the last existing list or a minimum date.

methods.name: with_is_default
methods.description: Returns a ResultSet with an additional boolean column indicating if the purchase list is the default for its project.

methods.name: with_ingredients_count
methods.description: Returns a ResultSet with an additional column counting the ingredients related to each purchase list.

methods.name: with_items_count
methods.description: Returns a ResultSet with an additional column counting the items related to each purchase list.
